frozen_design.purpose: Estimate realized out-of-rack fruit utility from choosing a treatment by known accession-specific action predictions rather than pooled action average
frozen_design.utility: sqrt(observed fruits), measured in different plants by action
frozen_design.source_model_baseline: P0 and P1 choose the same action (P1 only adds accession intercept)
frozen_design.fine_model: P2 adds accession × action shrunken residual (k=10)
frozen_design.holdout: five leave-one-rack-out fits, 4 training racks, single full matched action panel per accession heldout rack
frozen_design.eligibility: exactly one observed plant per treatment for each heldout accession×rack, determined before looking at outcomes
frozen_design.positive_gate: mean gain>0; conditional accession-bootstrap lower 95%>0; gain strictly positive in >=3/5 racks

limitations: Published experiment original Dryad 38/760 and course 44/879 remain unmatched
Accession is nominal genotype identity only; no molecular genotypes, whole genome or measured genetic causality
Four actions have assumed equal cost in simulation; costs not measured
Each action outcome measured in a different randomized plant, not individual treatment counterfactuals
Panel exclusions are for experimental layout only; main inferential sample is a selected 218 of 220 panels
Conditional bootstrap interval covers zero; cannot claim harmful decision effect
Positive prediction does not guarantee positive decision value
No source–target replacement map, history mode, or exact MLTR decision sufficiency tested
No raw source data or specimen response table committed
